description: This file implements IP range handling for the quiche QUIC library, including IP address truncation, comparison, and parsing from string.

classes.name: IpRange
classes.description: Represents an IP address range with methods for comparison and string parsing.

methods.name: TruncateToLength
methods.description: Truncates an IP address to a specified prefix length.

methods.name: IpRange::IpRange
methods.description: Constructor that initializes an IP range with a prefix and prefix length.

methods.name: IpRange::operator==
methods.description: Equality comparison operator for IP ranges.

methods.name: IpRange::operator!=
methods.description: Inequality comparison operator for IP ranges.

methods.name: IpRange::FromString
methods.description: Parses an IP range from a string in CIDR notation.

methods.name: IpRange::FirstAddressInRange
methods.description: Returns the first address in the IP range.
